final: WITH kept AS (SELECT account_id, type, amount, balance FROM trans WHERE amount >= 2400), step1 AS (SELECT account_id, AVG(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount WHEN type = 'VYDAJ' THEN 0 - amount ELSE NULL END) AS c2, AVG(balance) AS c3 FROM kept GROUP BY account_id) SELECT AVG(c2) AS avg_c2, AVG(c3) AS avg_c3 FROM step1
